text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bump into Symboli Rudolf in front of
the school
gates. She seems to be on her
way out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer. What an unexpected
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am. I was going to indulge in some...
social
studies, I suppose you might call
them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You can accompany me, if you'd like.
Assuming
you have no other obligations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With no other plans for the day, I decide
to go
with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us eventually arrive at the
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's see... What is on the schedule
today...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, not today.
choice_data_list: Did you come to watch the race?
Did you come to see the race?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse hosts all manner of
events in
addition to races.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They present good opportunities to gain
insight
into the general public's
perception of
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, I like to drop in and
take a look
when I have the time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as this is your first time, why
don't you
select the event?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf gestures to a
noticeboard
covered in posters for
various events.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Select whichever strikes your fancy and
we'll go
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Two activities in particular stand out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Cleaning up the stands, hm? I'll lead the
way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Volunteers of all ages and backgrounds
have
come to join the garbage cleanup.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hello there! Aren't you the Tracen
Academy
student council president?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am. It's a pleasure to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the pleasure's all mine! It's such a
joy to
watch you all on the track.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
I come along to these cleanups as my
own little
way of giving back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you. That's very humbling to hear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf takes the opportunity to
speak
with a variety of other volunteers
as we work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every one of them harbors clear
affection for the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf seems to take pleasure
in
listening to what everyone has to say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you for indulging me today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear that. I feel the same.
choice_data_list: That was a good learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I learned an important lesson today: our
fans
support us in various ways, even
when we aren't
racing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The next time I look out into the stands,
it will be
with a different sense of
appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the day draws to a close, I feel that
I've gotten
a rare glimpse of what
Symboli Rudolf values.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh? A limited-time exhibition of
Umamusume
achievements... And as luck
would have it, it
opens today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Surely this will be worth seeing. Shall we
take a
look?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Entering the venue, it's clear at a glance
that the
organizers have spared no
effort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see... They've collated the
achievements of famed Umamusume all
around the world, not just
in races, but
in the culture surrounding racing too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame this exhibition is only
temporary. The
organizers' passion for
Umamusume is plain to
see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I do wish it was better promoted,
though. Perhaps
there's something we
could do to help...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though subtle, there's a spark of joy in
her eyes
as she surveys the exhibit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy all it has to offer, with Symboli
Rudolf
occasionally chiming in as my
personal guide.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My, it has gotten late. Still, that was an
afternoon
well spent.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's important to remember that races are
more
than just contests of skill. They're
part of
Umamusume history and culture.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They form a great river of time and
devotion, flowing all the way from the
distant past to the
present we and our
fans inhabit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll see what I can do to have this
exhibition
advertised around the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you for indulging me today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear it.
choice_data_list: That was a good learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the day draws to a close, I feel that
I've gotten
a rare glimpse of Symboli
Rudolf's love for
knowledge.
